g.text: Prompt caching: where the cache actually lives
It's the KV cache from slide C3, kept after the request ends. It lives in HBM, not in the compute cores.
only the new tokens are computed
Accelerator HBM in the Region that served turn 1
kept for the TTL: 5 minutes by default, 1 hour on
Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.5 · min 4,096 tokens per checkpoint
With cross-Region inference, turn 2 can land in a different Region and miss the cache, so expect more cache writes.
AWS doesn't publish whether cached prefixes also spill to host memory or SSD.
Au. price for Sonnet 4.5: input $3.30/MTok · cache write $4.125 (5 min) or $6.60 (1 h) · cache read $0.33.
